prompt:
Main menu title screen background for a cute casual 2D game, 1920x1080, 16:9.
Flat vector illustration with soft gradients, clean anime-game UI art style, bright and cheerful.
Tangerine / mandarin orange theme: warm palette of tangerine orange, soft yellow, cream white, with fresh leaf-green accents.
Left side: a huge, semi-transparent tangerine slice silhouette partially cut off by the left edge, subtle and faded into the background like a watermark motif.
Scattered four-pointed sparkle stars in white, pale yellow and light orange across the upper area.
Soft glowing bokeh circles and floating bubbles near the bottom, slightly blurred.
A few small tangerines with green leaves and tiny citrus slices floating softly in the mid-ground, not too busy.
Right side: a lighter, calm vertical area with a soft pale-cream translucent panel, kept mostly empty for a logo and menu buttons.
Rounded decorative frame border around the whole screen in deeper orange with a soft inner glow.
Background gradient from light
